description_en: Deletes a specified face image from a user in the face database
description_zh: 调用该接口，从人脸底库的用户中删除指定的人脸图片
name: DeleteFaceUserPicture

parameters.help_en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value of IsolationId that you specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html operation to add the user
parameters.help_zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html接口添加用户时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致
parameters.name: isolation_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID. Set this parameter to the UserId value that you obtained and saved locally after calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html operation to add the user
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID。请传入在调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html接口添加用户后，获取并保存到本地的**UserId**值
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the user's face image. Set this parameter to the Data value that you obtained and saved locally after calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312040.html operation to add a face image for the user
parameters.help_zh: 用户人脸图片的唯一标识符。请传入在调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312040.html接口为用户添加人脸图片后，获取并保存到本地的**Data**值
parameters.name: face_pic_md5

Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
